cards.title: Essays sound formal
cards.body: A formal essay sounds like a newspaper, not a text message. Write contractions out in full (do not, it is), replace slang (kids → children, a lot of → many, awesome → excellent) and leave out chatty words (like, totally, basically).

cards.title: Drop “I think”
cards.body: In an argumentative or informative essay, the whole essay is your view, so “I think” and “In my opinion” only weaken it. State the point: “Schools should…”. A narrative essay is your story, so “I” is fine there.

cards.title: The style check
cards.body: The Coach’s style check marks contractions, informal words, wordy phrases and vague words. Ask Quill “Does my essay sound formal?” for a deeper read.

prompts: Which informal word was hardest to replace?
Read one of your sentences aloud. Does it sound like an essay?
